repository.name: brown-wholesale
repository.scope: Approved Decus 537 and Wholesale 346 Bicep traffic audit plus directly cited Bicep and Azure DevOps definitions
repository.summary: Wholesale 346 provides the shared Cloudflare and API Management edge and shared application/data foundation. Decus 537 remains a distinct landing-zone foundation with no invented Aggregates or DecusDirect application hosts and held hub peering.

art_direction.name: Brown private Azure topology
principles: VNets are terrain boundaries and subnets remain network-view containment
bottom-left API Management through projects and data access to top-right external services
direct inferred and held evidence are visually distinct
APIM configuration, policies, products, named values, subscriptions, and partner relations remain metadata
art_direction.materials: uniform Azure semantic cubes on sourced VNet terrain
art_direction.typography: full Azure resource labels with compact evidence chips

zones.label: Focused runtime
zones.description: Wholesale API ingress, projects, shared data access, telemetry, and external egress

areas.label: Wholesale 346 spoke virtual network, Central US development
areas.description: VNet terrain contains only subnet-attached resources. PaaS services remain outside at resource-group scope.

evidence.claim: The development VNet declares 10.234.132.0/22 and 10.234.156.0/22 address spaces and its subnets.

areas.label: Decus 537 spoke virtual network, East US 2 development
areas.description: Distinct Decus VNet terrain contains DATA-subnet private endpoints and the MDOP-subnet pool only.

evidence.claim: Decus 537 owns a separate landing zone with distinct subnets and private endpoints; hub peering is gated and not deployed.
The audited topology places resources in SNET-WHS-346-APIM-CentralUS-DEV (10.234.157.128/27).
The audited topology places resources in SNET-WHS-346-VNetIntegration-CentralUS-DEV (10.234.156.64/26).
The audited topology places resources in SNET-WHS-346-DATA-CentralUS-DEV (10.234.132.0/25).
The audited topology places resources in SNET-WHS-537-DATA-EastUS2-DEV (10.218.57.0/26).
The audited topology places resources in SNET-WHS-537-MDOP-EastUS2-DEV (10.218.59.0/26).
